anatomy_lessons: Treat aquatic mutation as a coherent alternate body-plan study rather than a decorative fin pass.
Track tail-fan/fin structures separately from ordinary dragon tail termination.
Track wing membrane, fin-like secondary surfaces, dorsal/caudal fins and limb posture as independent design variables.
Compare adult and hatchling morphology before extrapolating proportions.
